summary: Pacific Booker Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing it will not proceed with a previously announced private placement and will instead undertake a new non-brokered private placement to raise up to $4,000,001.90 through the sale of up to 1,860,466 units at $2.15 per unit, each unit consisting of one common share and one warrant exercisable at $2.37 for 36 months. Proceeds will fund a preliminary economic assessment for its Morrison project and general corporate purposes. The offering is subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval and customary conditions. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine capital-raising filing, not a special situation.
